summary: NRx Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing logistics for its 2026 Annual Meeting, not a special situation. The board set December 17, 2026 as the meeting date and October 28, 2026 as the record date, with a virtual-only webcast format. Because the meeting falls more than 30 days from the March 23, 2025 anniversary date, prior proposal deadlines are void; the board set an October 25, 2026 Rule 14a-8 submission cutoff. No transaction, stake, or valuation terms are present; watch only for the definitive proxy and any nomination contests.
